name: skills
one_liner: A free grab-bag of small add-ons for Claude Code that improve its instruction file, tighten up React code, and help you set up automated background coding workflows.
buyer: A developer or small engineering team already using Claude Code who wants a few specific quality-of-life fixes (better CLAUDE.md, narrower React types, a GitHub Actions coding loop) without building them from scratch.
business_use_cases: A frontend team installs 'narrow-react-prop-types' to catch prop-type drift that unit tests miss, reducing production bugs.
A platform engineer uses 'build-iterated-agentic-loop' to stand up an automated, scheduled coding-agent workflow in CI instead of hand-building one.
A consultant uses 'improve-claude-md' as a quick paid audit tool when onboarding a new client's codebase to Claude Code.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI workflow audit' service built around running these skills against a client's repo and codifying the improvements.

steal_this: Turn 'design-control-loop' into a $99 done-for-you offer: interview a small dev team about their repetitive engineering task and ship them a working scheduled agent workflow by the weekend.
